experiment: 30-min daily optical exercise experiment (S2.2.p2); RNA extracted DM day 14 (S5.6.p1); 0.6 mL media (S5.2.p1)
assay: bulk poly(A) RNA-seq, Singular G4 50-bp PE; nf-core/rnaseq 3.11.1, GRCm39/Ensembl (S5.6.p2-p3)
system: C2C12 ChR2(H134R)-tdTomato mouse myotube 2D monolayers on grooved fibrin, 24-well plates (S2.2.p1, S5.2.p1)
sample_inclusion: 6 biological replicates (wells) per condition, 24 samples per experiment (FIG2 caption, S2.2.p2, S5.4.p1)
primary_estimand: effect of ~2 weeks of daily 30-min optogenetic exercise at 1, 4 or 10 Hz vs unstimulated control on muscle gene expression, within the 30-min experiment
planned_contrasts: 1 Hz vs control (30 min) (FIG2 d; S2.3.p1; paper count only in a bar chart)
4 Hz vs control (30 min) (FIG2 d; S2.3.p1; paper count only in a bar chart)
10 Hz vs control (30 min) (FIG2 d; S2.3.p1; paper count only in a bar chart)
repeated_measure_unit: none: each well is one independent sample
paper_method: DESeq2 (R 4.2.0) with apeglm LFC shrinkage, BH-adjusted p (S5.6.p4); each condition vs control within its experiment (FIG2 d caption)

paper_threshold.effect_note: log2(fold change) > 0.5 on the apeglm-shrunken LFC; up and down both counted

paper_results: 1 and 4 Hz give comparable up/down DEG numbers; 10 Hz the fewest in both experiments (S2.3.p1). 30 min: Myog, Myod1, Myh1/2/4/7 up at 1 and 4 Hz, not at 10 Hz (S2.3.p2-p3). 60 min: muscle genes down vs control; Myh2 the most significantly down gene at 10 Hz 60 min (S2.3.p1, S2.3.p3). GSEA Hallmark/GO prerank, FDR q < 0.25 (S5.6.p4).
enrichment_plan: GSEApy prerank on DESeq2 LFC and p, MSigDB Hallmark and C5 GO, FDR q < 0.25 (S5.6.p4)
